data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 12
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Hey, it's time to go)

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Goodbye… Adiós
Let's talk, come on… Vamos a platicar
In the waiting room, feeling fine.

[Verse]
Sitting here, flipping through a magazine,
Good morning… Buenos días, the doctor will see you soon.
Excuse me… Perdona, can I go first?
Claro, of course, take your turn.
Tell me… Cuéntame, how's it going today?
¿Que tal? Feeling okay?
Good vibes… Buenas vibras, that's what we say,
In the clinic, we'll be okay.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Goodbye… Adiós
Let's talk, come on… Vamos a platicar
In the waiting room, feeling fine.

[Verse]
Nurse calls my name, I stand up tall,
Okay… Vale, I'm ready for the call.
The doctor smiles, asks how I feel,
Good… Bueno, I say, it's no big deal.
He listens closely, nods his head,
True… Cierto, everything he said.
Come on… Venga, let's wrap this up,
De nada, thank you, as I stand up.

[Bridge]
One more step, then I'm out the door,
